visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair and a teal leather jacket smiles and speaks directly into the camera while holding a cup of latte that has a photographic portrait printed on the foam. The background is a sunny outdoor park area with trees and a white car. (2) The scene transitions to a brightly lit modern cafe interior where a small group, including a young boy in a green jersey, huddles around a low table. A professional camera on a tripod is positioned to film the coffee. (3) A close-up shot shows a 3D coffee printer nozzle moving precisely over a cup of latte, depositing dark brown ink to form a graphic pattern. The machine has a sleek black and silver design. (4) A waitress in a professional uniform with a neck scarf serves a finished latte with a family portrait printed on it to the young boy, who reacts with wide-eyed excitement and a broad smile. (5) Multiple close-up shots showcase different printed patterns on latte foam, including the 'NOVATEC' brand logo, a realistic family photo, and a portrait of an elderly woman. (6) A split-screen comparison appears, showing a digital photo on a smartphone alongside the printed coffee version to demonstrate the high fidelity of the print. (7) Two cups of latte with large 'RR' logos are shown on a white table; text overlays explain the difference in clarity between hot and cold beverage prints. (8) A screen recording shows a mobile messaging app with photos of the coffee being shared, followed by a montage of the boy eating waffles and enjoying drinks in the cafe lounge.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a female voice speaking in an enthusiastic, high-arousal tone over an upbeat pop BGM with a steady electronic beat. The vocal is clear and professional. (2) A sharp transition occurs as the boy's voice enters with a high-pitched exclamation of wonder. The music stays consistent, but the acoustic space shifts slightly to a cafe interior with very low-level ambient room tone. (3) A mechanical humming sound, representing the 3D printer, is layered subtly under the narration. A 'pop' sound effect is used to emphasize a transition. (4) The female narrator continues with a friendly, informative tone, detailing the features of the printing service. The music swells slightly in volume during visual montages of the coffee art. (5) The final phase features a mix of the host's laughter and a celebratory musical flourish as the video concludes with a prompt for audience engagement.
